Work Product, and every right in it, vests in Client as it is generated.
findings.explanation: Ownership of your work passes to the client as it is created, before you have received payment for your services.
findings.suggested_change: Work Product, and every right in it, vests in the Contractor until the Contractor receives full payment, upon which ownership transfers to the Client.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sharing the agreement. I am looking forward to starting, but I would like to request one quick update before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause, ownership of the work currently passes to the client as it is created before payment is received; I propose changing this so that work product vests in the contractor until full payment is received, at which point ownership transfers to the client. Best regards,
